endpoints.description: Full metadata for a dataset by id/name

limits.notes: Standard CKAN action API; no key for read. No documented hard quota. This is a metadata catalog (dataset discovery), not a data API — actual data lives at each dataset's resource URLs.

llmDocs.summary: Discovery catalog of 250k+ US government datasets across agencies. CKAN action API. Returns dataset metadata and links to resources; not the data itself.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Use /package_search?q=&rows=&start= for discovery and fq= for faceted filters (e.g. organization, tags). Then /package_show?id= to get a dataset's resources (downloadable files / sub-APIs). Treat this as a router to other sources.

exampleQueries.intent: Get resources for a specific dataset

gotchas: Returns metadata only; the real data is in each result's 'resources' array (CSV/JSON/API endpoints of varying quality).
Resource quality and freshness vary wildly across agencies; many links rot.
CKAN responses wrap payload in {success, result}; read result.results for search.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Catalog metadata is public domain; individual datasets carry their own licenses — check each dataset's license_id before redistributing.
